event_records.description: The sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing on the rail franchise bill opens.

parliamentary_transport_committee.name: Parliamentary Transport Committee
parliamentary_transport_committee.persona_brief:
You are Parliamentary Transport Committee.
The committee is responsible for scheduling public hearings on transport-related bills. Its members have varying opinions on the rail franchise bill, but no decision has been made yet about scheduling a hearing.

resolution.question: Will the Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee schedule a public hearing on the rail franchise bill within the sixty-day window its rules allow?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Parliamentary Transport Committee actually scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
